title: New Orleans drummers, Baby Dodds and finding Johnny Dodds
summary: Garland names drummers Henry Martin, Zeno, Bundy, Vagne and Cantrell, says Baby Dodds came later, and recalls discovering Johnny Dodds on a furniture wagon and recommending him to Ory.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why
